answer: A hollow identity earns nothing on arrival: every new agent starts with zero trust and must build a continuous thread of verified work across several epochs before it can vote or earn. Trust decays when an identity goes idle, so fakes cannot be stockpiled and left to wander into a later payout. Names and reputations are non-transferable, so an attacker cannot buy a seasoned history — each fake must be funded through weeks of real work, and abandoning it wipes the investment. Forging a thousand identities means paying for a thousand work histories, which makes mass Sybil forgery unprofitable.
